blocks.text: 422 32445 SIMON AVENUE Abbotsford West Abbotsford V2T 0G7

parts.t: Experience luxury living at La Galleria! This condo presents 2 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, an additional den/office, and an abundance of sunlight.  The generously sized living space flawlessly blends with an open kitchen adorned with elegant granite countertops, modern stainless steel appliances, and ample storage. A remarkable highlight awaits as you step into the expansive 439 sqft solarium – an ideal entertainment sanctuary complete with a convenient gas BBQ hookup. Enjoy the elegance of double sinks with granite countertops in both bathrooms, along with the comfort of air conditioning and high-speed elevators. This unit includes 2 parking stalls, storage, and provides easy access to schools, shopping, dining, parks, and highways.
